title: fix(core): a declared action's confirm dialog names the action
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbMRFuRAeCbsTfQZ2W3U1Pq6)_

Fixes #26580

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:点一个声明了 `confirmText` 的动作时,确认框的标题和确认按钮现在显示动作自己的名字(如「标记为赢单」),`variant: 'danger'` 的动作确认按钮变成红色危险样式。以前一律是「确认操作」+ 中性的「继续」。
- **为什么改**:用户在确认框里看不出自己确认的是哪个动作,危险操作也没有危险提示;Record Delete 早已这样做,声明式动作没有。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改 `ActionRunner` 的一个调用点,把已有的 `options` 参数传给已有的确认处理器;没有新键。另在 ui 门禁 `check-action-forward-parity` 的豁免表加四条(四个 action 渲染器的 `variant` 是按钮样式词表,不转给 runner)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` 的确认调用点与新的 `confirmOptions`;`ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.confirmNamesAction-26580.test.ts`;`ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs` 新增的四条 JUSTIFIED。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.confirmNamesAction-26580.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿;或在控制台点一个带确认文案的危险动作,确认框标题是动作名、按钮是红色的动作名。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ActionRunner` asked its `ConfirmationHandler` with the confirm message alone, so the console's `ActionConfirmDialog` always fell back to its generic `actionConfirm.title` / `actionConfirm.confirm` copy ("Confirm Action" / "Continue", 「确认操作」 / 「继续」), and a `variant: 'danger'` action confirmed through a neutral button.

The runner now fills the handler's existing `options` bag from what the action already declares (no new key, per triage comment 6437776331):

- `title` and `confirmText` are the action's `label`. Every console surface resolves the label against the locale's bundle before dispatch (`useActionTextLocalizer`), so the runner receives the localized string.
- `destructive: true` when the action declares the spec's `variant: 'danger'` (`ActionSchema.variant`, `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`), the same flag the record Delete passes, which paints the confirm button with `buttonVariants({ variant: 'destructive' })`.
- The cancel button keeps the host's copy. An action with neither a label nor the danger variant is asked with the message alone, exactly as before.

`ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` and `useConsoleActionRuntime` needed no change: both already forward and render `title`, `confirmText` and `destructive`. The `ConfirmationHandler` type is unchanged; its doc comment now names the runner as one of the bag's producers.

Where the danger-to-destructive styling lives: the runner turns the spec's `variant: 'danger'` into the handler's `destructive: true` (`confirmOptions` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`). The dialog turns `destructive` into the style: `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` sets the confirm button's `className` to `buttonVariants({ variant: 'destructive' })` from `@object-ui/components` (unchanged since objectui#11695). No other mapping is added.

**Gate table, one file outside the first claim (claim amended, comment 6440643307).** The runner now reads `action.variant`, so `ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs` owed `variant` on `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group` and `action:menu`. Those renderers' `variant` is `@object-ui/types`' `UIActionSchema.variant`, the button-style vocabulary (`default | primary | secondary | destructive | outline | ghost`), consumed at the renderer; the runner reads the spec enum on `ActionDef` (`primary | secondary | danger | ghost | link`). Forwarding it raw does not type-check and carries no `danger`, so the four omissions are JUSTIFIED entries (issue 26580), not forwards. The vocabulary gap itself is left open; see Acceptance notes.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.confirmNamesAction-26580.test.ts` (5 tests): a labelled action passes `{ title, confirmText }`; a labelled danger action adds `destructive: true`; a labelless danger action passes `{ destructive: true }` only; a CONTROL action with neither is called with the message alone; a cancel still stops the run.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `this.confirmHandler(confirmMessage, confirmOptions)` with `this.confirmHandler(confirmMessage)` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `888cfb538c5d` to `926b95771ab6`). The new file went red: Tests 3 failed, 2 passed (the CONTROL and the cancel case stay green, as expected). Restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The test imports the runner from source (`../ActionRunner`), so no `dist/` rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- The existing one-argument pins (`ActionRunner.test.ts` "should show confirmation", `ActionRunner.callContext-13063.test.ts`) use actions with no label, so they still hold unchanged; that is the CONTROL path.
- The confirm button repeats the action's label, as triage asked. A surface whose action reaches the runner without a label still shows the generic chrome.
- Open, not built here: an `action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu` node styled `variant: 'destructive'` (the `UIActionSchema` spelling) gets a neutral confirm button, because the runner reads only the spec's `danger`. Closing it needs a decision on the two vocabularies (map one onto the other, or retire one); it is reported to the seat as an open question. Declared actions dispatched by the console's spread-based hosts (`DeclaredActionsBar`, `page:header`'s `dispatchHeaderAction`) carry the declaration's own spec `variant` and are covered.

## Verification

All readings at head `84482207` unless named. The core suite and type-check ran at `88581363`; the later commit touches only `ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs`, so they still hold.

Before the JUSTIFIED entries it was red on `check-action-forward-parity.test.ts > the real repository > is green` (the four `variant` drops); the run before the closure build also failed `unit-registry-absence-collision.test.ts` on unbuilt workspace packages, a prerequisite, green after the build.
